principle: Scientific experiment gates and corpus-engineering gates are independent. A sealed prospective experiment must remain sealed while source, provenance, catalogue, rights, and representation work continues.

machine_resolvable.task: Materialize a canonical record-level corpus layer from the authenticated SigLA snapshot without redistributing prohibited raw payloads.
machine_resolvable.completion_scope: 802 checksum-authenticated local canonical source records; not independently verified inscriptions.

machine_resolvable.task: Populate inscription, occurrence, provenance and site tables from authenticated source-derived fields with source/license lineage.
machine_resolvable.completion_scope: 802 inscription/provenance rows, 5,144 occurrence rows and source-label site counts exported locally; root historical CSV scaffolds remain historical.

machine_resolvable.task: Reconcile the 15 named unresolved cases against lawful primary images/plates or independent authoritative witnesses where accessible.
machine_resolvable.completion_scope: Historical bounded primary-page inspections are retained as audit history. Following EFA's 2026-10-06 project-specific refusal, GORILA may not be expanded into systematic transcription, structured extraction, machine-readable derivation, or redistributed visual evidence. Remaining disputed physical readings require rights-compatible independent evidence and/or expert adjudication.
machine_resolvable.blocker: EFA expressly refused this project's proposed GORILA visual reproduction and creation/publication/redistribution/exploitation of structured or machine-readable GORILA-derived datasets, including AI-assisted and non-commercial research. Existing bounded inspections confer no permission to expand extraction. SY Zb 7 and disputed physical/metrological cases remain open for independent rights-compatible evidence or human review.

machine_resolvable.task: Complete source-level sign/transnumeration concordance and keep Linear B correspondences non-phonetic unless independently justified.
machine_resolvable.completion_scope: 376 source sign entries, 1,401 editorial groups and all 5,144 occurrence references exported; 4 unmatched source keys and 388 unkeyed occurrences preserved. Cross-script phonetic equivalence remains unestablished. Completion is the source-layer concordance and gap register, not independent adjudication or cross-script correspondence.

machine_resolvable.task: Refresh mutable repository metadata whose embedded content version predates the current repository state.
machine_resolvable.completion_scope: Mutable metadata and current integrity documentation aligned to repository version; source inventory count now scoped to authenticated derivative.

sealed_or_external.reason: No remaining software task can manufacture source independence. Keep outcomes sealed until a rights-compatible independent input/gold basis is available.

sealed_or_external.task: Palaeographic adjudication, uncertain sign identity, disputed segmentation/metrology where sources do not resolve conflict
sealed_or_external.reason: Expert adjudication is not required to finish corpus engineering; it is required to convert unresolved physical/source conflicts into stronger epigraphic claims.

ceiling_rule: PRE_EXPERT_MAXIMUM is reached when every machine_resolvable item is COMPLETE or SOURCE_BLOCKED by a concrete rights/access gate. Human/object adjudication and sealed experiments are evidence gates, not unfinished corpus engineering.
public_record_boundary: All 802 entries, 5,144 slots, 1,401 editorial groups and 376 source sign entries from one authenticated SigLA derivative are public as licensed source-only JSONL under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with attribution. EFA's 2026-10-06 project-specific refusal bars expansion of GORILA into a structured/machine-readable derivative or redistributed visual layer. Historical bounded inspections are audit history only. Raison–Pope reconciliation, physical object identities and independent expert review remain open subject to source rights.
